# Contributing

Thanks for helping out! Issues and pull requests are welcome at [ro80t/discoauth](https://github.com/ro80t/discoauth).

## Setup

Requires [Bun](https://bun.sh) (version pinned in `packageManager` in `package.json`).

```sh
bun install
```

## Before opening a PR

CI runs these on every pull request, so run them locally first:

```sh
bun run typecheck
bun run lint       # oxfmt --check && oxlint (bun run format / lint:fix to fix)
bun run test
bun run build
```

## Project layout

| File                  | Contents                                                |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src/index.ts`        | Public entry point (re-exports only)                    |
| `src/client.ts`       | `DiscordOAuth2` class (built on `REST`)                 |
| `src/rest.ts`         | `REST`: typed requests over `paths`, timeout, 429 retry |
| `src/types.ts`        | Public types derived from the OpenAPI schema            |
| `src/error.ts`        | `DiscordOAuth2Error`                                    |
| `src/cdn.ts`          | `avatarUrl` / `bannerUrl`                               |
| `src/schema.auto.ts`  | Generated by `bun run generate`; do not edit by hand    |
| `scripts/generate.ts` | Fetches Discord's OpenAPI spec and trims it to `KEEP`   |

Tests live next to the code as `*.test.ts`.

### Adding an endpoint

1. Add the path and method to `KEEP` in `scripts/generate.ts`.
2. Run `bun run generate` and commit the updated `src/schema.auto.ts`.
3. It is now callable via `rest.request(...)`. For a helper, add the response type to `src/types.ts` and the method to `src/client.ts`, with a test.

## Changesets

Any change that affects the published package needs a changeset:

```sh
bunx changeset
```

Pick the bump type (`patch` for fixes, `minor` for new features, `major` for breaking changes) and commit the generated file in `.changeset/` with your PR. CI/docs-only changes don't need one.

After merge to `master`, a "Version Packages" PR is opened automatically; merging it publishes to npm.
